fields.name: Name
fields.harnessHelp: Choose the local runtime that executes this Agent. Keep the local default if you are unsure.
fields.localDefaultHelp: Leave blank to omit the model field and use the local runtime default.
fields.modelCatalogEmpty: The current runtime has not returned a model catalog from an online Host yet. The local default is the safest choice.
fields.identityHelp: Set this Agent's identity and runtime.
fields.descriptionHelp: Summarize this Agent's responsibility in one sentence. This appears in team lists and pickers.
fields.instructionsHelp: Describe the role, boundaries, and expected behavior in plain language.
fields.capabilitiesHelp: Choose whether this Agent can dispatch background work, use timers, or create child sessions.
fields.advancedPropertiesHelp: Configure collaboration, skills, runtime, and safety by purpose — no JSON knowledge required.
fields.advancedVisualHelp: Only settings that can be explained and edited safely appear here. Empty values use runtime defaults; use Advanced YAML for rare custom extensions.
fields.noAdvancedConfigured: No advanced properties are configured for this Agent.
fields.toolsHelp: Choose which teammates this Agent can call and set optional tool timeouts or retries. Most teams only need the teammate selector.
fields.skillsHelp: Control which reusable skills the runtime may load. Keep the default unless you need an explicit allow-list.
fields.mcpHelp: Connect external tool services such as source control, documents, or business systems. Maintain complex server definitions in Advanced YAML.
fields.environmentHelp: Control where commands run, whether they can access local files directly, and which OS isolation is used.
fields.guardrailsHelp: Run checks or blocks before sensitive actions such as tool calls. Configure these only when you need explicit approval or safety rules.
fields.asyncHelp: Allow long-running work to be dispatched in the background; useful for Coordinators.
fields.timersHelp: Allow delayed or scheduled wake-ups. Most Workers do not need this.
fields.spawnHelp: Allow this Agent to create more child sessions when it needs to split work further.
fields.jsonHelp: JSON value. Unknown YAML fields remain untouched.
fields.secretConfigured: Configured — enter a new value to replace it
fields.complexYamlOnly: This value uses a complex custom structure. Edit it in Advanced YAML to avoid an unsafe rewrite.
fields.hiddenDefaults_one: {{count}} empty or default item is hidden.
fields.hiddenDefaults_other: {{count}} empty or default items are hidden.
fields.collaboratorsHelp: Selected Workers become teammates this Agent can dispatch work to.
fields.noCollaborators: There are no Workers to select yet. Add a teammate from the left panel first.
fields.skillAccessHelp: Use the runtime default, allow everything, disable skills, or provide a specific allow-list.
fields.authHelp: Runtime credentials. Existing secrets stay hidden and are replaced only when you enter a new value.
fields.extensionHelp: A runtime- or plugin-owned extension. Leave it unchanged if you are unsure.
fields.yamlEscapeHatch: Use Advanced YAML for system-level and custom structures.

sandboxType.help: No isolation grants full local access; Linux/macOS sandboxes restrict files, processes, and networking.

policyType.label: Policy type

cwd.label: Working directory
cwd.help: . uses the working directory selected for the session.

sandbox.label: OS isolation
sandbox.help: Limit access to local files and processes.

type.label: Isolation mode
type.help: none disables OS isolation, allowing access to resources available to the current user.

blast_radius.label: Change-scope check
blast_radius.help: Check the impact radius before high-impact operations.

on.label: Trigger
on.help: For example, tool_call runs before each tool invocation.

function.label: Check function

path.label: Function path
path.help: Python import path for the policy implementation.

arguments.label: Policy options
arguments.help: Options passed to the check function.

gate_pushes.label: Gate pushes
gate_pushes.help: Require this policy to pass before code is pushed.

feishu.title: Feishu
feishu.description: Connect this bundle's coordinator surface. Run state remains in Orvia.
feishu.modalDescription: Connect {{agent}} through its Coordinator. Workers never own separate Feishu connections.
feishu.coordinatorOnly: This connection belongs to the current Agent Bundle and its Coordinator.
feishu.entrySettingsDescription: Choose what this Agent may do in Feishu and review the floating-menu mapping to publish in the developer console.
feishu.detailsEntryHelp: After a task starts, this entry appears at the top of the Feishu chat and opens that Session in the Web UI.
feishu.localDetailsWarning: This address only works on this computer. Use an intranet or public address for Feishu on your phone.
feishu.quickEntriesHelp: Controls which menu events and interactive-card actions this Agent accepts. Every Agent can use a different combination.
feishu.nativeMenuLimit: Capability switches do not add or remove the floating menu in Feishu. Orvia rejects menu events for capabilities that are not enabled.
feishu.floatingMenuDescription: In the Feishu developer console, enable the bot custom menu, choose the floating style, and configure each menu item to push an event.
feishu.menuEventType: Subscribe to this event type once
feishu.menuPublishHint: Create and publish an app version after editing; changes take about five minutes to appear.
feishu.menuSingleChatHint: The floating menu supports bot direct chats only and requires Feishu 7.22 or later. Send one direct message before using it for the first time.

entryActionHelp.quick_commands: Start a new session or end the current one

feishu.authorizedDirectoryHelp: Saved directories are added to this Agent's allow-list. Feishu can switch only between these directories.
feishu.saveAndCreateGrant: Save configuration and create QR code
feishu.detailsEntrySynced: Execution details is synced to Feishu.
feishu.notConnected: Create a device grant, then scan it in Feishu. The bot surface is provisioned automatically after connection.
feishu.scanHelp: Keep this window open while authorization completes.
feishu.grantExpired: This QR code expired. Create a new device grant.
feishu.workingDirectoryHelp: This is only the default directory when this Agent first creates a Feishu session; it does not lock later sessions. Each member and Feishu conversation can later use a different directory. A non-Git container directory with multiple Git projects is supported.
feishu.bindingPending: The selection is ready locally. Send the bot a message before persisting it to a Feishu chat binding.
feishu.surfaceDescription: A guide card is sent after connection, a greeting, or a new session. Run, log, stop, and approval controls appear only when that context exists.
feishu.defaultScopeDescription: This is the Agent's default starting point. Every Feishu conversation can still switch directories later.
feishu.defaultScopeRequired: Save a default local directory on an online host before connecting Feishu.
feishu.stateSource: Feishu is only an entry, notification, and necessary-approval surface; Orvia remains the state source.
